note: Static observations of FlowJo 10.6.2 (official installer FlowJo-OSX64-10.6.2.dmg, sha256 90721621498618ec824e85f91e494d4d1249a31e9767ff840aec6b7342a32f08), recorded as REA original-case Evidence by tools/reaProof.ts. Behavior is described in words; no FlowJo code or disassembly is stored. Spec: docs/validation/flowjo-engine-specs.md.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: The polygon gate mask has gateResolution x gateResolution cells; cell (x, y) is set exactly when the integer point (x, y) lies inside the vertex-rounded polygon (even-odd crossings with the half-open rule y1 < y <= y2) or on one of its edges or vertices.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Vertices (and, in the gate computation, event values) map to the grid as floor((v - min) * R / (max - min) + 0.5) on linear axes, and as the lookup-table index scaled to R and truncated on table axes; values are read as 32-bit floats.

observations.subject: engine
symbols: FGate::GetRectRangeInScale(double&, double&, double&, double&, TransformedParameter*, TransformedParameter*)
observations.behavior: A rectangle bound whose channel floor((b - min) * C / (max - min) + 0.5), C = max(channel range, 4096), is <= 0 (lower) or >= C (upper) is replaced by an open bound; other bounds are kept.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: An ellipse is sent to the engine as a polygon: 180 outline points at angles 2 pi (i / 180) (fraction in single precision), polar radius a sqrt((1 - e^2) / (1 - e^2 cos^2 t)) from the integer major/minor edge points, rounded to integer frame pixels, consecutive duplicates dropped, converted back to data values; the engine then gates it as a polygon.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: The median is read from a 4096-channel histogram: the first channel whose cumulative count (single precision) reaches n * 50 * 0.01, converted back to a data value; no interpolation.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Histogram channels are floor(u + 0.5) clamped to the first and last channel, so off-scale values fall into channel 0 or the last channel.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Robust CV is 0 for populations of fewer than 6 events; otherwise 100 x robust SD / median, robust SD being (P84.13 - P15.87) / 2 with one-sided fallbacks at saturation.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: A new child name that no sibling uses is kept; a taken name becomes the first free <stem>-N (N = 1..999), the stem dropping a trailing dash plus up to 3 digits when that dash is after the 3rd character; names compare exactly.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: A newly drawn shape is discarded when it is 10 px or less in both width and height (a range: 10 px or less wide); any larger shape is kept.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: A new file relinks to the first workspace sample without data whose saved $TOT is present and equal, whose saved $DATE, $BTIM, $BEGINDATA are equal up to the first unsaved one, and whose $FIL is unsaved or equal; otherwise the file is a new sample.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Deleting a quad population also deletes every sibling quad on the same x and y parameters, wherever its centre; a population whose gate is not a quad is deleted alone.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: The cell cycle model is fitted on a histogram of min(parameter channel range, 1024) channels; the user cannot set the resolution.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Workspace undo keeps the last 100 edits (Swing UndoManager default; no class in FlowJo-10.6.2.jar or fjlib-2.3.0.jar sets another limit), undoes and redoes them in order, and a new edit after an undo drops the redo edits.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Up to 4 keyword criteria; an active criterion has a keyword and a non-empty value. The result starts true and every active criterion applies its connector (And, Or, And-not), the first included. A missing keyword tests false; the six comparisons are numeric when the trimmed sample value is a number, otherwise case-insensitive string order; Contains / Lacks are case-insensitive substring tests; Exists is true when the keyword is present.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Without stain sets and an active first criterion a group accepts nothing; listed stain sets must contain the sample's stain set (trimmed non-empty $PnS of non-scatter, non-time parameters joined with ', '); a reference group combines with 'also' (either) or 'only' (both), any other function accepting nothing.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Eight roles written as ws.group.dlog.<role>; read back by substring of the upper-cased text (TEST, CONTROLS, COMPENSATION, INSTRUMENTATION, MFO, COPY), so replicate, baseline and gating level read back as undefined.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Copy analysis to group makes the subtree group-owned in every member; in a synchronized group moving a group-owned gate moves it in every member; deleting group analysis offers Allocate To Samples (keep in every member, sample-owned), Allocate To First Sample (keep only in the first member) or Delete Entirely (remove from every member).

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Mean, SD, CV and geometric mean come from a 4096-channel histogram on the parameter's scale: mean = sum of count x channel value / n (single precision); SD = sqrt(sum of count x (channel value - mean)^2 / (n - 1)); CV = 100 x SD / mean, not absolute; geometric mean on a linear axis = 10^(sum over channels >= 1 of count x log10(channel) / n), converted back.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Mode: a 256-channel histogram; the first (lowest) channel with the highest count, as a position on the 4096-channel axis, converted back to a data value.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Median Abs Dev: m = the 4096-channel histogram median; the absolute deviations of the events from m are sorted and the element at floor(n / 2) gives 100 x 1.4826 x deviation / m.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Correlation returns NaN; the engine has no other correlation implementation, so FlowJo 10.6.2 shows no correlation value.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: A Statistic element is written with name = the StatKey string as is (Count, fj.stat.freqofparent, fj.stat.freqof, Median, Mode, Geometric Mean, Median Abs Dev, Correlation, ...), id = parameter, percent, ancestor (ancestor name) and correlate (second parameter); Freq. of = 100 x count / ancestor count.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: No more than N: step = trunc(count / N) (1 when equal); events are written every step-th in file order until N are written; whole sample from position 0, gated population the step-th, 2 step-th, ... event (1-based); N at or above count writes every event.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: CSV: comma-separated, newline-terminated; scale values printed with %g, values within 1e-6 of zero as 0; channel values as integers on 1024 channels by default; header = parameter name, stain, or both joined with ' :: '.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Concatenation groups: all, every n consecutive, or equal keyword values (string order, empty values left out); populations ordered by $ETIM; per-population cap trunc(sum of min(N, count) / populations); a SampleID parameter holds the 1-based position.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Sibling quads are one composite: quad (kind 7) centre from the upper-left child, x < cx left and y < cy lower (a value on a line goes right or up, NaN below), exact on scale values; offset quad when the upper-right child's corner differs (one divider steps); bisector (kind 8) below the split left, the split value and above right, NaN left.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: PolyQuad (kind 11): four polygons ordered by the bounding-box corner each has; an R x R label grid gives each lattice point the first polygon (upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right) containing it, points in none count as upper-left; events take the label of their cell (polygon cell mapping).

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Magnetic gate: from the drawn position, walk one cell at a time over a 256 x 256 parent histogram toward the count-weighted centre of the covered cells (x when |dy| <= 2.41 |dx|, y when |dx| <= 2.41 |dy|, sign of 0 is +1), stopping after 512 steps or on a revisit (the lower-scoring of the last two); 1-D: shift by bins while the count keeps increasing.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Contour plot: adaptive smoothing (s = ceil(13 n^-1/4), w(j) = exp(-0.5 j^2 sqrt(n) (2.4/13)^2), kernel sums to 1, margins mirrored); bins above 0.005 sorted by density, a level each time the running mass passes N / levels; closed iso-lines, frame-touching regions closed along the frame.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: 1-D histogram request without a length: min(channel range, 4096) channels; smoothing spreads each bin of count n over ceil(13 n^-1/4) bins each side with the same Gaussian weights; left margin mirrored, the first two padding bins past the right edge lost; values printed with %9.0f (whole counts).

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Tools: Arrow, Rectangle, Range, Quad, Bisector, Ellipse, Polygon, Pencil, Auto Gate, Curly Quad, Spider Quad; keys S E F A P I R Q X C; labels = stain else parameter; quads 'Q<n>: <x>+/- , <y>+/-' (UL Q b, UR b+1, LR b+2, LL b+3, b past used numbers); bisector '<label>-' / '<label>+', clash '<parameter>::<label>-/+'.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Curly quad on a 256-pixel frame, k = 0.001 fixed and not saved, arms sampled about 1/40 of the remaining span, sent as polygons; spider polygons (corner x, side y), corner, (side x, corner y), centre, side points 10 px from the click, corners one unit outside the axis; .wsp: gating:CurlyQuad, spider PolygonGate quadId 0..3.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Pencil commits a vertex beyond 12 px when (d + a) / c > 1.04 or d / bend > 12, fewer than 4 points abandons; Auto Gate always at the 2% contour level, 256 resolution, picks the polygon with the nearest vertex (last vertex skipped, first wins) and keeps every (n div max(20, trunc(0.1 n)))-th vertex.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Convert: rect corners to polygon; bounding boxes snapped outward to whole scale units; ellipse outline 180 frame pixels reduced to 20; rect to ellipse through the corners. Copy adds sibling quads; paste keeps coordinates, clears the group, skips a target with the same child name and refuses a sample missing a parameter.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Manual entry: Lower / Upper in Intensity or Percentile; percent gates recomputed per sample from the parent's smoothed histogram (4096 buckets x, 256 y), whole-count running sum to p x count; anchored range bound = statistic x multiplier (clicked value / statistic, 2 decimals, Shift snaps, Alt upper), not draggable.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: BifurGate: per fluorescent parameter off the gating path, the parent's smoothed 4096-channel histogram; peaks found by half-width walks and regression slopes, small or low peaks dropped, the two largest kept; the split is the first lowest channel between their interpolated medians; '<label>-' / '<label>+' children, unimodal gives none.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Request attributes yAxis, statistic (nine names, unknown = Median), percentile, smoothing (None / Median = none, Gaussian, Moving Average), thresholdType 0 threshold / 1 thresholdStart, thresholdEnd, thresholdPercentile; reply Kinetics range = R with Plot1D values printed %6.5f, missing bins 0.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: R = last event time - first (file order, last 0 -> 1); width max(1, trunc((R - 1)/4096 + 1)), bins trunc((R + width)/width) <= 4096; minimum events per bin by statistic, else k = max(10, N div minimum) bins of width trunc(R/k + 1); bin trunc(t / width) clamped, origin 0; smoothing width 3.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Per bin on scale values with y >= T (T = 0 without a threshold): single-precision mean; geometric mean from display channels; % over T over the gated events of the bin; percentiles streamed in file order into a 4096-channel histogram, the event opening a bin counted in the bin before, the file's last event always processed; empty bins missing.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Width 3: moving average weights 1; Gaussian weights exp(+k^2/w^2) (positive exponent); weighted mean over present bins within 3, edges renormalised; missing bins stay missing.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Absolute threshold as given; percentile threshold: FindTimeSlice's result discarded, the timeslice start and end truncated used as an event-index range for a 4096-channel percentile (>= 100 maximum, <= 0 minimum).

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Timeslices: All Events [0, n x scale] unsaved; drag makes 'Range #k' with a name prompt, clashes -1, -2; multiple ranges back to back of total / number, prefix1.., y 50, 75, 55, 80; auto slices around the longest zero run and the first maximum ('Auto #'); threshold dialog absolute 0.1 or percentile 95 of a slice; time axis $ETIM - $BTIM seconds.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Gap fill once; channels round(t x tmax / W) of the X parameter; dt = (end - start)/(channel span); points trunc(start/dt) to trunc(end/dt) exclusive, zeros next to zeros skipped; peak, peak t = (index + 1) dt, mean Y = sum/(m dt), AUC = mean Y x span, slope = LS slope / dt (m > 1).

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: KineticsNode in the population's Subpopulations with yAxis, statistic, percentile, smoothing, absoluteThreshold, threshold, thresholdPercentile (-999999 unset), thresholdTimesliceName, yAuto, yMin, yMax, colorIndex and Timeslice children (color #rrggbb); statistics plat.kin.startt .. plat.kin.dt with id = timeslice.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Formula upper-cased; EVENT # then each parameter name (longest first, every occurrence) replaced by a variable; variables take compensated scale values, Event # the 0-based index; results stored as float32; at most 8 variables (a 9th overwrites slot 0).

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Split at the rightmost lowest-priority operator (all left-associative, unary sign above ^); priorities & | < = <> < relational < + - < * / % < ^ < ! < unary; functions sin..norm with if(c,a,b), sd/cv over n-1; % truncates, ^ special cases; error messages 'Illegal math parameter.' etc.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Types importCsv, importClr, algebraic, analytic, eventNumber, synthetic, clusterFrequency, consensus; algebraic attributes name, id, type, formula, useNormalizedData and a Transform child; a formula of exactly 'Event #' makes the event-number parameter.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Derive Parameters: name letters/digits/underscore and not a number ('Paramter with this name already exists'), default 'Derived', 'Derived-1'..; formula with Insert Reference / Function / Operator; scale linear 0..1000; .wsp DerivedParameter node wrapping DerivedParameter name type formula with Formula and Transform children.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Header must start FCS (or MQD); versions 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 3.1 and 3.2 accepted; only the first letter after $Pn is read (B, E, G, N, R, S), so $PnDATATYPE is ignored; $DATATYPE I, F, D, A; $ENCRYPT must be NONE.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Widths <= 8 -> 1 byte, 9-16 -> 2, 24, 32, 64, others 'Encountered unhandled data width'; packed bit stream (LSB first, not reset per event) when the last <= 16-bit parameter is not 8 or 16; 3-byte little-endian unless big-endian; $BYTEORD 1,2 / 1,2,3,4 / 12 / 1234 little else full reversal; integers masked with next-power-of-two($PnR) - 1; $TOT 0 -> DATA length x 8 / bits per event.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: SSM(i, j) = sqrt((P84_P,j - med_P,j)^2 - (P84_N,j - med_N,j)^2) / sqrt(med_P,i - med_N,i) from 4096-channel percentiles of the positive and negative populations; 0 when the denominator is not positive or the result is NaN.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Spillover LU-decomposed (eigen least squares for spectral), each event solved; compensated parameters named Comp- + name.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: .mtx = Gating-ML root with transforms:spilloverMatrix (parameters, spillover rows of positional coefficients); CSV corner-cell layout; wizard spillover = (medP_j - medN_j)/(medP_i - medN_i) with 0 -> 1, populations need 100 events and 2% of parent, FlowJo badge texts.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Dean-Jett-Fox: Gaussians plus a broadened quadratic S between the means; Watson: Gaussians plus an erfc plateau with fitted kG1/kG2; G2 searched in 1.75-2.25 x G1, unconstrained by default; RMSD over every channel; no chi-square output.

observations.subject: engine
observations.behavior: Division, Proliferation, Expansion, Replication indices and % Divided = sum_{g>=1} N_g/2^g / (N_0 + sum_{g>=1} N_g/2^g); generation means r^i mu0 - (1 - r^i) offset, ratio 0.5 or estimated in [0.42, 0.54]; default 4 peaks.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Defaults noUndo false, autoSave false every 10 minutes, eventsOnAxis true at 5%; Don't Ask memory is a set of message keys answered Yes without asking, offered on statistic, population and sample delete (group delete always asks), emptied by Reset All Don't Show Memory; auto-save only for a workspace already saved that has samples, status 'Auto-Saved <name> on EEE, d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss'.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Axis flagged when the fraction of events on its lower or upper bound is greater than threshold/100; message percent int(100 x (sum of four fractions + 0.005)), below 98 'Warning: %d% of events are on the chart edges!' else 'Warning: Nearly all events are on the chart edges!'.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Table columns are statistic, keyword or formula (formula over same-row columns); iteration by sample, keyword value or panel of N tubes; CSV with ' (%)' after Freq. headers, ',' cells quoted and quotes doubled, TAB first header 'Sample:', HTML; summary Mean and Std. Deviation; heat map blue to yellow; batch tiles across in a fixed number of columns or one per page; delete texts 'Are you sure you want to delete this table? ' / layout.

observations.subject: jar
observations.behavior: Editing a sample's $PnS keyword sets the parameter stain (SampleKeywordProxy.install -> GParameter.setStain); acquisition keywords are not editable (isEditable); the Graph Window axis title is name + ' :: ' + stain when a stain exists, else the name (ParameterID.getLongName), under showStain (default true).
